subject.title: fix(cron): preserve one-shots rescheduled during active runs

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for active one-shot rescheduling, replacing or reconciling the overlapping open implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111408?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same persisted cron ownership failure but use overlapping implementation approaches. Choosing a single landing path is an ownership and integration decision that cannot safely be inferred from the branch diff alone.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Review its broader ownership-marker approach against the earlier PR, then close or supersede the overlapping branch with credit preserved.

options.title: Reconcile into the earlier PR
options.body: Transfer any unique marker, A→B→A, pacing, or completion-path coverage into the existing proof-positive PR before landing one consolidated fix.

options.title: Pause both for owner design review
options.body: Hold both branches if maintainers want a different durable run-generation contract before changing one-shot completion semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Review its broader ownership-marker approach against the earlier PR, then close or supersede the overlapping branch with credit preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current author is the only supplied contributor with the complete expanded implementation and reproduction context; metaforismo should be included in the reconciliation discussion.
